metadata.title: Groupicorn Mississippi IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Mississippi is represented by an initial regional catchment pair and a sourced anchor; remaining logo-backed leads stay in the verification queue until exact-site evidence is checked.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset. Existing asset provenance and license clearance require separate review where source URLs are not yet recorded.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.
